mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a rising demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and GDP growth rate signals a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1% and an increase in the money supply trigger an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production and a decline in the federal funds rate signal an increase in supply and a decrease in borrowing costs, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth and low interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).
